prompt: A tall multi-story building is shown as a cross-section diorama made of folded paper, revealing stacked residential units inside. One distinct set of rooms on a middle floor is brightly lit from within, showing a tiny sofa and table, clearly isolated as a single home on one floor. layered cut paper filling the whole frame, real depth between the layers, crisp cast shadows, visibly fibrous card and translucent tissue, raking side light. Never a box, a shadow-box or a picture frame around the scene — the paper IS the world, not an object sitting inside one. One square illustration. The scene is fully rendered and fully inhabited — no silhouettes, no flat icons, no diagram, no empty schematic space. A single subject dominates the frame and everything else is arranged around it. Absolutely no text anywhere in the image: no letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or pseudo-text.
